instructions.name: bind_tournament_pass
docs: Organizer-only: requires a tournament pass for every later registration. The pass must
already be initialized with this program's pass registrar and a rating policy that covers
the tournament's range.

accounts.name: pass_config
docs: in the handler.

accounts.name: black_authority
docs: Program ID, so omit SystemAccount and mut constraints. Joined wallets
receive refunds only when passed writable by the client.

accounts.name: white
docs: Included only to match the registered crank account list.

instructions.name: issue_pass_eligibility
docs: Attests the player's profile rating to the tournament's pass program by CPI, issuing or
refreshing their eligibility so a pass can be transferred to them. Anyone may call it.

accounts.name: eligibility_record
docs: the pass program.

instructions.name: register_player
docs: Registers the signer. The rating is read from the signer's `PlayerProfile`; when the
tournament has a pass binding, one pass is burned as the ticket and the signer's unrevoked
pass eligibility record must be the first remaining account.

accounts.name: pass_binding
docs: the organizer bound a pass mint to this tournament; `load_pass_binding` checks the rest.

accounts.name: pass_mint
docs: Required only for tournaments with a pass binding; checked against it in the handler.

instructions.name: revoke_pass_eligibility
docs: Organizer-only: revokes a player's pass eligibility through the registrar PDA, so the
pass can no longer be transferred to them, and a pass they already hold can no longer be
redeemed to register. A revoked record is never refreshed.

accounts.name: white
docs: `white` recorded on the (seed-verified) `game` PDA. Only the key is used,
to register the same player accounts the crank will later be invoked with.

accounts.name: magic_program
docs: Not touched by the handler; it must be in the account list because the
scheduled `crank_time_check` task CPIs back through MagicBlock.

instructions.name: set_pass_paused
docs: Organizer-only: pauses or resumes every transfer of the tournament's pass through the
registrar PDA. Redemption by registering is not affected.

fields.name: dispute_bond_lamports

fields.name: crank_max_slot_delay

fields.name: crank_max_seconds_early

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for PDA derivation.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved space for zero-migration additions.

types.name: RecoveryIdentity
docs: Permanent seat and wager binding. Never delegated, reassigned, or closed.

types.name: TournamentPassBinding
docs: Ties one tournament to its pass mint. A separate account keeps the deployed `Tournament`
layout unchanged. An empty, system-owned binding address means the tournament needs no pass.
